stories.title: CDC report: Ebola outbreak could rival the worst on record unless world acts
stories.summary: New modeling from the CDC shows that if measures aren't taken immediately, this outbreak could sicken more than 20,000 people in the next three months.

stories.title: Ex-Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino spoke at an international far-right conference
stories.summary: Former Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino recently spoke at an international far-right gathering alongside white supremacists and neo-Nazis.

stories.title: GLP-1s might reduce risk of cancer. Researchers are asking why
stories.summary: There is mounting evidence to suggest GLP-1 drugs designed as diabetes and obesity treatments also help reduce cancer risk.

stories.title: In the wake of layoffs, some tech workers are exploring new careers
stories.summary: Amid widespread tech layoffs, some highly skilled workers are making radical career changes. Some laid-off workers are turning to lower paying temp jobs, and some are leaving tech altogether.

stories.title: Even America's 250th birthday has grown tumultuous
stories.summary: The United States is throwing a big 250th birthday party this summer. Planning between two groups has become highly politicized.

stories.title: New album by the band Red Clay Strays has this reviewer feeling grateful
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Laura Grant of station WEXT in Albany, N.Y., about new music out Friday by the Alabama-based band The Red Clay Strays.
